dialogs.about: 이사 전날 딸과 함께 짐을 싸요

lines.en: Mother, are we going to pack today?
Yes. The movers will come tomorrow.
Where are the cardboard boxes?
In the garage. I bought them yesterday.
Should I write on them with a marker?
Yes, please. Write the room name on each box.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 상자마다 방 이름을 적어요.

lines.en: These plates are fragile. I will be careful.
Thank you. Stack the light boxes here.
This one is heavy. Can you lift it?
lines.ko: 이건 무거워요. 들어 올릴 수 있어요?

lines.en: Leave that one. The movers will load it.
lines.ko: 그건 두세요. 일꾼들이 실어 줄 거예요.

dialogs.about: 이사 날 아침에 이삿짐 일꾼과 트럭 앞에서 이야기해요

lines.en: Good morning, Ma'am. Are these boxes ready?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 사모님. 이 상자들 다 됐어요?

lines.en: Yes, we packed everything last night.
Which ones are fragile?
The boxes with the red marker.
I see. We will load them last.
Thank you. Please lift that one slowly.
Don't worry. We carry fragile boxes carefully.
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요. 깨지기 쉬운 상자는 조심해서 옮겨요.

lines.en: Can you stack the cardboard boxes there?
Sure. Then we will drive to your home.
Thank you. My daughter will unpack them.
